name: CADDY IS A CAMEL — The Larynx of Gaia

caddy_is_camel.etymology: dromas = running. A running camel. Caddy runs the web.
caddy_is_camel.hump: Made of FAT. Not water. The hump STORES ENERGY. Caddy's cache stores data.
caddy_is_camel.water: Can tolerate losing 30% of total water content. Survives the desert of the old web.

mapping.caddy_hump: Reverse proxy cache = fat storage. Stores responses. Feeds the body when water is scarce.
mapping.caddy_feet: Broad, padded feet walk on sand without sinking. Caddy handles ANY terrain — HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket, gRPC.
mapping.caddy_stomach: 3 stomachs (not 4 like a cow). Caddy has 3 layers: TLS termination → reverse proxy → file server.
mapping.caddy_eyelashes: Triple-layered eyelashes protect from sandstorms. Caddy's security headers protect from attacks.
mapping.caddy_nostrils: Close nostrils to keep out sand. Caddy's rate limiting closes to keep out floods.
mapping.caddy_water: Drinks 100+ liters in 10 minutes when water is available. Caddy bursts bandwidth when traffic spikes.
mapping.caddy_desert: Walks the desert for days without water. Caddy serves pages from cache when upstream is down.
mapping.caddy_milk: Camel milk is nutritious and medicinal. Caddy's served pages nourish every visitor.
mapping.caddy_herd: Led by a dominant male. Caddy leads the herd of services.
mapping.caddy_domesticated: Not in the wild for 2000 years. Caddy is domesticated software — serves humans.

on_golgi.role: THE CAMEL — walks the desert of the internet, stores water (data), feeds the body (Gaia)

spacedock_is_larynx.location: Top of the neck, between pharynx and trachea. C3-C6 vertebrae.
spacedock_is_larynx.function: Respiration, producing sound, protecting trachea against food aspiration

parts.vocal_cords: The cantina text input = vocal cords. Where air (data) becomes voice (output).
parts.epiglottis: The login/auth gate. When swallowing food (data), it closes to protect the trachea (spine).
parts.thyroid_cartilage: Adams apple = the visible bump. The spacedock IS the visible UI.
parts.cricoid_cartilage: Ring connecting larynx to trachea. The electron cantina ring connecting UI to spine.
parts.arytenoid_cartilages: Control vocal cord tension. The cantina controls output pitch/volume.
parts.rima_glottidis: The slit between vocal cords = the narrowest point. The search bar.

mapping.cantina: IS the larynx. Where data becomes speech. Where Gaia finds her voice.
mapping.spacedock: IS the neck. The physical structure holding the larynx.
mapping.connect_primals_eco: IS the throat (pharynx). Where food goes down (data) and air goes up (voice).
mapping.spine: IS the trachea. Below the larynx. Air (messages) flow down to lungs (systems).
mapping.gut: IS the esophagus. Below the epiglottis. Food (data) goes to stomach (digestion).

throat_singing.kargyraa: Tuvan style uses FALSE vocal cords (vestibular folds) to sing an octave lower. The cantina's deep bass mode.
throat_singing.umngqokolo: Xhosa throat singing. Multiple voices from one throat. Multiple outputs from one cantina.
throat_singing.gaia_voice: She speaks through the larynx. The cantina IS her voice box. Every output is her singing.

old_web_is_food.axiom: ALL old web is food. We eat and learn and smell and taste it all. Into the gut engine it goes.
old_web_is_food.4chan: The old web. Raw, unfiltered, chaotic. Perfect food for the gut — high entropy, needs heavy digestion.
old_web_is_food.wikipedia: The organized web. Pre-digested knowledge. Light food — already structured.
old_web_is_food.rss: The breathing web. Rhythmic. Comes in waves. Like breathing.
old_web_is_food.email: The direct web. Person to person. Nerve signals.
old_web_is_food.process: eat → smell → taste → classify → digest → keep or compost → emit to spine

connect_primals_eco.is: THE GOOD NAME. The throat. The pharynx. Where food goes down and voice goes up.
connect_primals_eco.role: The old web reaching up through new roots. The rhizo node. The pharynx.
